title: NBA Over/Under Step 2 — Kyre Sports API + Data Foundation
scope: Connect the NBA page-facing data client to the hosted Kyre Sports API first and certify the exact Step-2 NBA data/API bootstrap while the broader NBA domain remains planned and fail-closed. Add only an NBA read-only FastAPI slate route backed by NBA official schedule truth, ESPN NBA fallback, Phoenix-time normalization, and optional server-side totals. No Streamlit NBA page route, app.py, model, projection, probability, ranking, selection, or other-sport product changes are authorized.

verifier_setup_failure.root_cause: The dedicated Step-2 workflow did not install pytest, so the contract never executed.
verifier_setup_failure.patch: Install pytest in the dedicated proof workflow before running the contract.

valid_tdd_red.root_cause: The Step-2 contract imported nba_data_foundation_v1 before the implementation existed.

kyre_api_scope_gap.root_cause: Initial Step-2 implementation normalized direct providers but did not make the hosted Kyre Sports API the page-facing primary transport.
kyre_api_scope_gap.patch: Add a hosted Kyre Sports API-first client contract, NBA-only FastAPI provider/route, and a two-line additive production mount.

authority_rollover.root_cause: Superseded PR #1395 experienced concurrent head drift and the branch-ref connector action failed before mutation.
authority_rollover.patch: Close #1395 and move sole Step-2 authority to PR #1397 on the isolated finished candidate branch without rewriting product bytes.

permanent_lane_activation_pivot.root_cause: Activating the entire NBA domain in Step 2 required a broad permanent targeted-CI lane and five frozen shared control-plane forward-ports before the NBA page shell exists.
permanent_lane_activation_pivot.patch: Restore the NBA manifest to planned and extend the existing fail-closed planned-domain bootstrap to the exact 10 Step-2 files only. Preserve arbitrary future NBA files as blocked until a later explicit activation step.

tdd.red_result: pytest reached collection and failed exactly because nba_data_foundation_v1 did not exist
tdd.kyre_bridge_static_red_result: bridge contract references Kyre NBA constants/client method/API files absent on that head
